title: Add or remove items
description: A real first-fit bin-pack — removing an item from the middle of the grid opens a gap the next added item actually reuses.

title: Align & distribute selected items
description: alignSelected/distributeSelected — align a multi-selection to an edge, or evenly distribute the ones between the outermost two.

title: Alignment guides while dragging
description: Figma-style guide lines wherever the dragged item's edges align with another item's — purely visual.

title: Localizable ARIA strings
description: Every user-facing string in GridItem — the close button's label, aria-roledescription, and keyboard instructions — is overridable.

title: autoScroll
description: Dragging or resizing near the edge of a scrollable container scrolls it automatically.

title: Auto-size grid on content
description: autoSize is true by default — most consumers never need to think about it, but it's worth knowing about for the opposite case.

title: Basic drag & resize
description: The simplest possible setup — a GridLayout bound to a layout array, drag and resize on by default.

title: Blocked-move feedback
description: move-blocked-by-collision fires the moment preventCollision blocks a drag or resize.

title: Border radius
description: Setting useBorderRadius/borderRadiusPx on GridLayout cascades to every GridItem that doesn't set its own.

title: Bounded drag to container
description: With isBounded enabled, items can't be dragged past the edges of the grid container.

title: Show close button
description: Setting showCloseButton on GridLayout controls the default for every item that doesn't set its own.

title: compactNow, rearrange & duplicateItem
description: On-demand layout tidying and item duplication, exposed on the GridLayout instance.

title: Drag, drop from grid to grid
description: Both grids set allowCrossGridDrag — drag an item from one into the other.

title: Cross-grid drop restrictions
description: disableExternalDrop rejects an incoming cross-grid drop — items can still leave, just not arrive.

title: Custom drag handle & close button
description: Combines the library's own exported CustomDragElement and CustomCloseButton instead of the defaults.

title: Custom drag-placeholder content
description: The #placeholder slot renders custom content inside the internal GridItem the library uses for the drag placeholder.

title: Custom header slot
description: The #header slot renders a separate region above an item's own main content.

title: Drag activation distance
description: Minimum pointer movement, in pixels, before a pointerdown is treated as a drag rather than a click.

title: Drag allow / ignore elements
description: dragAllowFrom restricts dragging to a specific handle; dragIgnoreFrom excludes specific descendants.

title: Edit mode toggle (view-only dashboard)
description: enableEditMode is a master switch — off, an item can't be dragged, resized, or closed regardless of its own props.

title: Events
description: Every event GridLayout and GridItem emit, plus the lower-level eventBus events used internally between the two.

title: Grid dimensions (rowHeight, colNum, margin)
description: The three core sizing props every grid uses, adjustable live.

title: Show grid lines
description: Renders visible grid line guides behind the items, useful while building a layout or as a permanent visual aid.

title: Height modes (heightMode)
description: The modern replacement for autoSize, with two modes ('scroll'/'fit') a boolean couldn't express at all.

title: Horizontal shift
description: Pushes colliding items left/right instead of down, during an active drag/resize.

title: Layout bounds & rendering options
description: maxRows caps growth; distributeEvenly spreads overflow items instead of clamping; useCssTransforms toggles the positioning strategy.

title: Layout lifecycle events
description: layout-ready fires once, after every item's size has stabilized; layout-updated fires on mount and after every subsequent change.

title: Mirrored (RTL)
description: is-mirrored flips the entire grid for right-to-left locales — anchor edges, resize direction, and drag math all reverse together.

title: Multi-select & group move/resize
description: Select multiple items and drag or resize any of them — the rest of the selection moves or resizes by the same delta.

title: Multiple grids
description: Each GridLayout creates its own eventBus — grids never share state, so there's nothing to namespace or configure.

title: Named layout presets
description: Save and switch between several named arrangements of the same items.

title: Drag, drop from outside into multiple grids
description: Each grid independently decides whether to accept a native drag released over it.

title: Drag, drop from outside
description: allowOutsideDrop accepts native HTML5 drag-and-drop from anywhere outside the grid system entirely.

title: outsideDropAccept & readOutsideDropPayload
description: Reject incompatible native drags before the placeholder appears, and read a richer, typed payload than the raw DataTransfer.

title: Per-item autoHeight
description: A real ResizeObserver on the item's own content, not a one-time measurement.

title: Per-item zIndex override
description: An explicit stacking-order override that wins over the library's own implicit static/dragging/resizing rules.

title: Pluggable compaction (compactType & compactor)
description: Five built-in strategies via compactType, or replace the algorithm entirely with a custom ICompactor.

title: Prevent collision
description: Blocks a drag/resize from overlapping another item entirely, rather than pushing it out of the way.

title: Resize direction toggles
description: Toggle any of the 8 resize edges/corners live and watch resizeHandles update in real time.

title: Configurable resize-hint appearance
description: showResizeHandles renders a visible resize affordance instead of only a cursor change on hover.

title: Responsive breakpoints
description: Auto-generate a layout per breakpoint, based on container-width thresholds.

title: Responsive predefined layouts
description: Pre-define exactly what each breakpoint's layout looks like, instead of relying on auto-generation.

title: Restricting resize handles to specific edges
description: resizeHandles restricts which of the 8 edges/corners actually resize — distinct from showResizeHandles's show/hide visibility toggle.

title: v-model & save/load layout
description: layout is a plain, JSON-serializable array — persist it however you like.

title: scrollToItem & focusItem
description: Scroll a possibly off-screen item into view, or move keyboard focus straight to it.

title: Size constraints & aspect ratio
description: minW/maxW/minH/maxH clamp resize bounds; preserveAspectRatio locks the width/height ratio while resizing.

title: Snap to grid
description: Magnetic snapping during drag — distinct from alignment guides, which never change where an item lands.

title: Spacing indicators
description: A labeled distance badge in the gap to the nearest neighbor on each side — an independently toggleable sibling to alignment guides.

title: Static items
description: A static item ignores isDraggable/isResizable entirely, is excluded from the drag-collision cascade, and its close button is hidden even if showCloseButton is set.

title: Export layout as SVG
description: A dependency-free utility producing a standalone SVG snapshot of the current layout.

title: Switching layouts & forcing a remount
description: A plain v-model reassignment handles switching layouts — a :key change forces a genuine remount when internal state needs resetting too.

title: Configurable transition duration & easing
description: transitionDurationMs and transitionTimingFunction control the CSS transition applied to position/size changes.

title: Undo/redo (enableUndoRedo)
description: Opt-in history at committed-change granularity, not per intermediate drag-move frame.
